purpose: Teach: 建材/渡米/前月/スペシャリスト/リコール/各所/積む/段ボール

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、建材の盗難事件、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are pursuing the building materials theft investigation with full commitment, and we're genuinely grateful for that.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Steady cadence—no rush. Deliberate emphasis on commitment. Slight nod-weight on 'investigation.' Warm professional respect underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の渡米、本気で、絶対、当社からも、絶対、警察様に、絶対、ご連絡しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been in contact with the police about the suspect's travel arrangements, and we truly appreciate your efforts.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive tone. Nods along with the rhythm of cooperation. Clear articulation—showing he's tracking the details. Genuine deference to the officer without obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 前月の犯罪統計、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、共有させていただきます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll be sharing the previous month's crime statistics with you—the police will have full access to that information.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Brisk but not rushed. Information-delivery tone—efficient, clear. Slight formality in the phrasing, as if reading from procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のセキュリティスペシャリスト、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. If it would help, we'd like to introduce you to our security specialist—we'd be grateful for your guidance on this.
lines.style: Helpful, slightly deferential. Offers the assistance as a natural next step. Warm but businesslike. The courtesy of someone asking permission before moving forward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯機器の、本気で、絶対、リコール、絶対、警察、絶対、注視、絶対、いたしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're monitoring the security equipment recall closely, and the police department will have our full attention on this matter.
lines.style: Serious, focused tone. Slight weight on 'monitoring' and 'attention.' Professional concern—not alarm, but genuine engagement. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各所への、本気で、絶対、警察様の、絶対、巡回、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'd appreciate regular patrols in all the relevant locations—please let us know how we can support that.
lines.style: Accommodating, responsive. Open-handed—offering support as the natural stance. Polite but direct. The tone of someone committed to being part of the solution.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 押収品、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、積むこと、絶対、警察、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The seized materials are being handled with utmost care and stacked according to proper protocol—we're taking this very seriously.
lines.style: Reassuring, methodical. Careful emphasis on 'utmost care' and 'proper protocol.' Deliberate pace—showing competence. Slight satisfaction in demonstrating thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠保管の、本気で、絶対、段ボール、絶対、警察様の指示、絶対、従っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're following all your instructions exactly regarding evidence storage and packaging—everything's being documented carefully.
lines.style: Precise, earnest compliance. Crisp articulation—showing attentiveness to detail. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' at the end. The reassurance of someone who takes procedure seriously.
